key_provisions_or_claims: Observatory provides a global resource for policymakers, regulators, academia, industry and civil society on AI ethics and governance.
Rooted in the 2021 UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI adopted by 193 countries.
Readiness Assessment Methodology helps governments assess preparedness; country profiles in the Global Hub.
Expert networks include Business Council for Ethics of AI, AI Ethics Experts Without Borders, and Global Network of AI Supervisory Authorities.
Resources include toolkits and a synthesis of 55 national RAM reports.
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Landing page of UNESCO's Global AI Ethics and Governance Observatory, a platform offering country profiles, Readiness Assessment Methodology outputs, expert networks, toolkits and news to support implementation of the 2021 UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI. General AI focus with no robotics content.
